data.title: Fiscal sustainability, AI infrastructure and supply chain resilience on APEC finance ministers' agenda
data.description: Eduardo Pedrosa, Executive Director of the APEC Secretariat, says this week's APEC finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong will focus on making fiscal policy sustainable and better-targeted, building digital infrastructure for AI, and preparing workforces for the changes ahead. He also highlights supply-chain resilience as a priority, as energy and food price pressures and Middle East chokepoints pose risks across the region.
